problem: What linear transformation $T$ is represented by the matrix $T=[\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{3} & 0 \\ 0 & \frac{2}{3}\end{aligned}]?$
worked_solution:
Recall that a dilation of scale factor $k$ is represented by the matrix

$$
[\begin{aligned}k & 0 \\ 0 & k\end{aligned}].
$$

Here, we have $k=\frac{2}{3}.$ Therefore, the matrix represents a dilation with a scale factor of $\frac{2}{3}.$
